label: user-supplied current-client observations
evidenceClass: user-entered observations; screenshots of the current game read by hand, not independently reviewed
registrationNote: Not in index.json nativeMeasurements and not accepted by lib/solver/observations.js: the intake takes observed length/width/near/far readings with a capture hash, and these records carry hand-read pixel rows without stored images or hashes.
roleNote: Outside every holdout set. Used to check the new-game forward model, its half outline and the zero-length rule (ADR-0014).

source.imageNote: The images are not committed and their hashes were not recorded; only the screenshot ids below were noted.

client: current game (after the October 1 2026 update, build 2000922 assumed); exact build not recorded
userStatement: cl_crosshair_length has to be 1; the outline is dependent on it, outline cannot be shown without the length applied. Read as: length 0 draws no bars and no bar outlines. No capture of a dot at length 0.

alphaAnalysis.method: Orchestrator re-analysis (2026-10-02) of the screenshot pixel values: effective alpha = (observed - background) / (outline colour - background) per channel, in linear light (sRGB decoded), over outline pixels next to background. A reading from 8-bit pixel values, not a colour-managed measurement.
alphaAnalysis.conclusion: The current game does not multiply cl_crosshairoutline_a by cl_crosshaircolor_a. Exporting cl_crosshairoutline_a = old crosshair opacity reproduces the old outline opacity (ADR-0015).

modelComparison.model: communityForward length 1, thickness 8, gap 2 at 1080 (width 8, near 2, far 2); half outline as nativeOutlineExtent mode 2 {low 1, high 0}
modelComparison.result: Both captures match the core raster and the half-outline raster pixel for pixel up to a whole-shape translation (tests/lib/edge-cases.test.mjs).
modelComparison.translationNote: Absolute position is not compared: the hand-read crop origin is not a calibrated centre.
